_comment: Reference values for ASE-DFTFE automated tests. Energy in Hartree, forces in Ha/Bohr. null = NOT pinned: the suite FAILS on it. Seed deliberately with `test_suite.py --seed` on a binary you trust, never by accident.
_schema: test_suite.py reads exactly two keys per case: 'energy_ha' (float) and 'forces_ha_per_bohr' (N x 3 list). 'forces_rmse_mev_per_ang' below is a FOSSIL of an older RMSE-based schema and is read by nothing; see the note on n2_nonperiodic.

n2_nonperiodic._note_forces_rmse: Dead key, read by no code. 8694.97 meV/A is not an error-vs-reference: this case holds N2 at 2.6 Bohr = 1.376 A, ~25% beyond the 1.098 A equilibrium bond, where a several-eV/A restoring force is the correct physics. Do not 'fix' it; if it bothers you, delete it.

relax_o2._note: listed in test_suite.RUN_ONLY: completion is the assertion, values are not compared

al_slab_semiperiodic._source: NOT SEEDED. Must be established with --seed on a real binary carrying the open-direction fix (dftfe/install/cpu_real), not invented.
